Team — looping you in to validate the answers before I send back to Novacorp. Maya asked for concise bullets; Ill draft a short RFI reply and attach our data-lifecycle summary + SOC2 assertion. Notes below (please flag any factual corrections):

- Region defaults: us-west-2 primary for new tenants; fallback to us-east-1 for disaster recovery. EU/APAC options via region opt-in (sales/procurement).
- Retention: request/response bodies retained for 30 days by default for hosted API; embeddings stored for 180 days if embeddings feature enabled. Logs/metrics (aggregated) retained 365 days; detailed request traces retained 90 days unless customer requests otherwise.
- Purge flow: tenant-initiated purge starts with immediate deletion from primary stores (within 24 hrs), KV/prefix caches invalidated within 48 hrs, full confirmation when background snapshot GC completes (up to 30 days depending on backup window). Backups included in purge scope; we surface expected timeline as "up to 30 days".
- KV caches: runtime KV caches are ephemeral and cleared on purge; persistent prefix caches are tombstoned and removed from cache layer during purge job.
- Geo-isolation: tenant pinning available on hosted for certain SKUs (dedicated pools). Standard hosted tenants can request region opt-in at onboarding; strict per-tenant geo-enforcement for hosted multi-tenant requires a dedicated allocation.

Ben/lauren/sean — any additions/corrections? Ill consolidate and send to Maya with the attachments.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Security Solutions (Security and Compliance)

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the clear list. Below are concise answers for your vendor pack. I've attached a short "hostedapi-data-lifecycle-summary.pdf" and our signed SOC 2 assertion for completeness. If you need machine-readable answers (spreadsheet), tell me and Ill push the MAQ sheet.

1) Where customer content is stored by default (region/region fallback rules)?
- Default write/read region for new hosted tenants: us-west-2.
- Automatic failover: if us-west-2 is unavailable, requests will route to us-east-1 (DR).
- EU/APAC: Regional tenancy in EU/APAC is available on request during onboarding; customers must opt into those regions.

2) Retention policy for request logs and generated responses (hosted tenants)? Any separate retention for embeddings?
- Request/response bodies: retained 30 days by default (short-term operational retention).
- Embeddings: retained 180 days if embeddings feature is enabled for the tenant.
- Aggregated logs and metrics: retained 365 days.
- Traces/request-level debug logs: retained 90 days by default.

3) Deletion/erase procedure when tenant requests full data purge (timelines/backups)?
- Trigger: customer support or tenant admin can open a purge request.
- Immediate actions: primary data stores are marked for deletion and primary objects removed within 24 hours.
- Cache invalidation: runtime KV and prefix caches are tombstoned immediately; complete eviction across all nodes completed within 48 hours.
- Backups/snapshots: purge jobs schedule a background GC; snapshots/backups are included and subject to scheduled retention windows — final irreversible removal can take up to 30 days depending on snapshot cadence.
- Confirmation: we provide a purge report with timestamps when all steps are confirmed complete.

4) Enforcement across cached KV data, prefix caches, and model KV caches?
- Runtime KV cache: ephemeral, cleared as part of purge job (no long-term persistence).
- Persistent prefix caches: entries are tombstoned and removed from cache tiers; the purge job also updates the control-plane index so future cache warm-ups will not rehydrate purged data.
- Model KV caches (e.g., for serving optimizations): any tenant-identifiable tokens/keys are scrubbed; model weights and shared parameters are not tenant-specific and are not considered customer content.

5) Per-tenant geo-isolation (region pinning) availability and constraints?
- Available: Yes, via a regional opt-in during onboarding for standard hosted customers. For strict per-tenant enforcement (hard region boundary and physical isolation), we require a dedicated pool (Dedicated offering) or Private deployment.
- Constraints: region pinning on shared hosted pools carries limits on traffic locality during failover; true legal/geofence guarantees require Dedicated or Private deployments.

Attachments included: hostedapi-data-lifecycle-summary.pdf (summary + timelines), signed-soc2-assertion.pdf (attestation). Ive also prepared a spreadsheet of the answers (novacorp-maq.xlsx) if you prefer.

If anything here needs further evidence or a short attestation line for procurement, let me know and Ill add it.

Regards,
